more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children; table-top sweeteners in powder form.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
High-dose animal studies found no reproductive or developmental harm.
more_info.overview: Crosslinked sodium carboxymethyl cellulose is a thermally crosslinked sodium salt of partly carboxymethylated cellulose. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. The specified material is supplied as white powder. EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in powder form, table-top sweeteners in tablets, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,.
